newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CMB ponders Hessenatie bourse listing.
newsitem.headline: CMB ponders Hessenatie bourse listing.

text.p: Belgian diversified shipping group CMB said on Wednesday it was considering a bourse listing for its port activities unit Hessenatie.
"We have been thinking about this, but there is nothing concrete yet," chief executive officer Marc Saverys told the annual shareholders meeting in Antwerp.

Hessenatie is a major player in Belgium's leading ports of Antwerp and Zeebrugge. The unit had 1996 net profit of 650 million Belgian francs. In 1996 the CMB group had consolidated net profit of 4.38 billion francs.
